heroSection.title: Benefit Discounts
heroSection.subTitle: Benefits-First Discount Directory
heroSection.description: A public directory of the discounts companies offer to people on federal financial support programs such as SNAP, Medicaid, or more.

mainContent.overview: Built and launched a public directory of the discounts that private companies, state governments, and cultural institutions offer to people on SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, and similar benefit programs. Readers pick their benefits and state to see matching offers in three languages, each linked to the provider's official page and rechecked weekly. Built with Next.js and Postgres on Vercel.

keyFeature.body: Pick the benefits you hold and your state, and the list narrows to the offers open to you
Discounts from private companies, state governments, and cultural institutions in one searchable list instead of scattered across separate sites
English, Spanish, and Chinese in both Simplified and Traditional scripts, with translations held back whenever the English entry changes
Every entry shows when it was last checked, and a weekly sweep flags any source page that has changed since
Every entry links to the provider's official page, one click from the authoritative terms
Never calculates whether you qualify, never asks for documents, and carries no affiliate links
No account and nothing collected. Filters and your saved list stay on your device, with a printer-friendly view

walkthrough.subheader: Pick what you hold, see what is open
walkthrough.description: One control card asks where you live, what you have, and what you want covered, and the list narrows as you answer. Search forgives typos, results sort four ways, and any program can be saved to a list on your device that has its own tab and a printer-friendly view. Pages are pre-rendered and readable without JavaScript.

walkthrough.subheader: Everything about one offer on one page
walkthrough.description: Each program has its own page with the full benefit detail, the official link, and the last checked date. Benefits appear under your state's name for them, and multi-venue programs link to every participating location. The page flags a changed source and offers a link to report a problem.

walkthrough.subheader: The same list in English, Spanish, and Chinese
walkthrough.description: The whole site is available in English, Spanish, and Chinese in both Simplified and Traditional scripts. Each language lives at its own address, and your browser's language is picked by default. When an English entry changes, its translations are held back until they are reviewed, so no language shows an older offer.

walkthrough.subheader: A queue of what needs checking next
walkthrough.description: A GitHub login limited to approved emails opens a queue sorted by what was checked longest ago, flagging pages that changed since. Verifying an entry takes one click, and translations are edited next to their English. The panel also handles backup, restore, and file imports.
